sections.content: Use the futuro simple in questions to ask what someone will do, where they will go or when something will happen. The question structure is straightforward: ¿Qué harás?, ¿Dónde vivirás?, ¿Cuándo viajarán? Short answers can use the same tense: Viajaré en julio. The future ending shows who will act.

items.english: Where will you live next year?

sections.content: Keep the full infinitive before the future ending: viajaré, trabajarás, vivirán. Do not remove the -ar, -er or -ir ending before adding the futuro simple ending.
